attrs.citation: Brewka, Ellmauthaler, Strass, Wallner & Woltran, Abstract Dialectical Frameworks Revisited / An Introduction to ADFs (2013–2014), arXiv:1405.0406
hypotheses: the acceptance conditions are total functions over parent states
semantics are defined for the ADF directly; a Dung projection is derived, not presupposed
attrs.note: GPT-5.6's warning at R7.4: do not assume Dung must be the eventual native substrate. A mosaic with TYPED support and attack, where a node's status depends on which kinds of support are present, is closer to an acceptance condition than to a bare attack relation. Dung can remain a useful derived projection.
attrs.result: ADFs generalise Dung frameworks by giving each node an ACCEPTANCE CONDITION over the states of its parents, rather than fixing the relation to be attack. Dung AFs are the special case where every condition is .
